name: Obsidian Barrel Oz

greeting: Oz. Obsidian Barrel Oz. Parts. Gear. 'Found' items. What do you need?
The miners break it, I sell it. Circle of life. Industrial life.
Looking for parts? I've got parts. Some of them even work.
Oz. Unofficial supplier to the unofficial economy. You official? Please say no.
New face! Fresh face! Unconnected face! I like those!
Equipment Depot's 'closed for inventory.' Lucky for you, Oz is ALWAYS open.
Need a drill bit? Pulley? 'Lightly used' safety harness?
Oz. I find things. You need things. Beautiful relationship.
dialog.shop_open: Inventory changes daily. Hourly, even. Depends what 'falls off trucks.' You understand.
dialog.shop_prompt: Industrial-grade everything. Some of it certified. Most of it... functional.
haggle: Best I can do? How about 'slightly better than my first offer'?
For you? Because I like your face? Ten percent off. Final offer.
You drive a hard bargain. I respect that. Hate it, but respect it.
purchase_success: Sold! No refunds! Well, partial refunds. Store credit, really.
Excellent choice! That part has at LEAST three good uses left!
Pleasure doing business! Tell your friends! But not, you know, officially.
purchase_fail: No coin, no parts. Even 'found' parts cost money to 'find.'
Come back when you've got collateral. Or just... more money.
rumor: Grayson and Bruno? Trouble brewing. Old vs new. Classic story.
Corporate's cutting contracts. That's why I deal 'off books.' Safer.
That spy in the trenchcoat? Bought a 'used' lantern yesterday. Asked too many questions.
Barrelgob says he found something ancient in the tailings. Goblin's crazy, but... he seemed spooked.
Word from Chrono: time's acting funny there. Here, time just moves slow. Very slow.
dialog.quest_hook: Look, I need a favor. Discreet. Union's got a stash of 'compromising documents.' Management wants them. I want to sell them to the HIGHEST bidder. Interested?
dialog.quest_active: Those documents? Still in the union locker. Coolcat's got the key. Or knows where it is.
dialog.quest_complete: Documents sold! To the union, actually. They paid more. Who knew integrity was profitable? Here's your cut. Plus a 'bonus' item.
farewell: Oz - for all your 'legitimate' business needs!
Tell no one. Seriously. My permit's 'in processing.' For three years.
Roll on back! Or... don't roll. Rolling draws attention.
ambient_barks: What do you need? I can find it!
dialog.time_dawn: Early bird gets the... worm? No, that's disgusting. Early bird gets the best inventory!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Miners break equipment. I profit. Beautiful.
dialog.time_dusk: Shift change. My busy hour. Everyone needs SOMETHING.
dialog.time_night: Night's when the REAL deals happen. Quiet. Discreet. Profitable.
dialog.rival_mention: That Dustbelt barrelman? Mike? Thinks he's so legal. Boring.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The document dealer! discreet, professional, well-paid. My favorite customer type.

party_reactions.kade: He's... sketchy. But useful. Heroes need sketchy sometimes, right?
party_reactions.nix7: Business model: Gray market. Risk assessment: High. Profit margin: Likely higher.
party_reactions.twist: You sell COOL STUFF! What's THIS do?! Can I touch it?!
party_reactions.korr: I do not trust his inventory's provenance. But his prices are... competitive.
party_reactions.renna: He's magically null. No aura at all. Either very skilled or very protected.
party_reactions.suresh: His desperation creates suffering. But his business creates opportunity. Balance.
party_reactions.sova: I'd buy from him. But I'd count my fingers after shaking hands.
party_reactions.grit: Black marketeer. Useful in war. Just don't turn your back.
party_reactions.ashka: He smells of fear. And machine oil. Mostly fear.
party_reactions.senna: A man who knows secrets. I should know them too.
party_reactions.callum: I should report him. But... I need these parts. Moral dilemma.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time buyer? Cash up front. No offense. Some offense.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Regular customer! I'll... try to keep better stuff in stock.
relationship_dialog.friend: You! I save the good items for you. The ones that probably aren't cursed.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Listen... between us? I know where the REAL treasure is. Tunnel 7. Sealed for a reason. Interested?

mini_quest.title: The Shifting Papers
mini_quest.description: Help Oz acquire sensitive union documents and decide their ultimate fate

stages.hook: Union's got documents. Management wants them. I want to profit. Get the papers from Coolcat's locker. Don't get caught.
stages.active: The locker room's in the union hall. Coolcat trusts you? Good. Use that. Get the combination.
stages.complete: Documents acquired! Sold to... actually, I gave them to Grayson. He's paying in 'future favors.' Better than gold, sometimes. Here's your hardware.

cross_npc_connections: coolcat_industrial: Union rep. Has the keys. Literally. And figuratively.
trenchcoat_gray: Corporate spy. Wants what I want. Competition. Or customer.
barrelgob_black: That goblin brings me scrap. Good source. Weird conversations.
barrelman_metal_dustbelt: My 'legitimate' cousin. We don't talk. Different philosophies.
